source: Network UPS Tools 2.8.5, docs/nut-names.txt (the RFC 9271 registry) and data/cmdvartab (upsd's own descriptions). Generated, do not edit by hand.
note: `n` stands for an index (sensor, outlet, group); DOMAIN x CONTEXT x SPEC per nut-names.txt:520-638.

variables.device.type: Device type (ups, pdu, scd, psu, ats)
variables.device.macaddr: Physical network address of the device
variables.ups.status: UPS status (opaque string comprised of space-separated tokens; many of those are ascribed certain meanings)
variables.ups.alarm: UPS alarms (opaque string, may be a collection of whole sentences; separate entries may be enclosed in brackets for convenience, but this standard does not require it)
variables.ups.load.high: Load when UPS switches to overload condition ("OVER") (percent)
variables.ups.delay.start: Interval to wait before restarting the load (seconds)
variables.ups.delay.reboot: Interval to wait before rebooting the UPS (seconds)
variables.ups.delay.shutdown: Interval to wait after shutdown with delay command (seconds)
variables.ups.timer.start: Time before the load will be started (seconds)
variables.ups.timer.reboot: Time before the load will be rebooted (seconds)
variables.ups.timer.shutdown: Time before the load will be shutdown (seconds)
variables.ups.test.result: Results of last self test (opaque string)
variables.ups.test.date: Date of last self test (opaque string)
variables.ups.display.language: Language to use on front panel (*** opaque)
variables.ups.efficiency: Efficiency of the UPS (ratio of the output current on the input current) (percent)
variables.ups.beeper.status: UPS beeper status (enabled, disabled or muted)
variables.ups.mode: Current UPS mode (see the note below)
variables.experimental.ups.mode.buzzwords: classified (opaque string, presumably comprised of space-separated tokens; see the note below)
variables.ups.start.battery: Allow to start UPS from battery
variables.ups.start.reboot: UPS coldstarts from battery (enabled or disabled)
variables.ups.shutdown: Enable or disable UPS shutdown ability (poweroff)
variables.input.transfer.reason: Reason for last transfer to battery (*** opaque)
variables.input.transfer.low.min: smallest settable low voltage transfer point (V)
variables.input.transfer.low.max: greatest settable low voltage transfer point (V)
variables.input.transfer.high.min: smallest settable high voltage transfer point (V)
variables.input.transfer.high.max: greatest settable high voltage transfer point (V)
variables.input.eco.switchable: Input High Efficiency (aka ECO) mode switch (opaque string)
variables.input.feed.color: Color of the input feed (opaque string)
variables.input.transfer.frequency.bypass.range: Frequency range Bypass transfer point (percent of nominal Hz)
variables.input.transfer.frequency.eco.range: Frequency range ECO transfer point (percent of nominal Hz)
variables.input.transfer.hysteresis: Threshold of switching protection modes, voltage transfer point (V)
variables.input.transfer.bypass.forced: Rule for allow auto Bypass switch (on/off) transfer modes (enabled or disabled)
variables.input.transfer.bypass.overload: Rule for auto transfer on Bypass when overload (enabled or disabled)
variables.input.transfer.bypass.outlimits: Rule for auto transfer on Bypass when out of tolerance (enabled or disabled)
variables.input.bypass.switchable: Input auto transfer on Bypass when overload or out of tolerance (enabled or disabled)
variables.input.bypass.switch.on: Automatically put the UPS in Bypass mode
variables.input.bypass.switch.off: Automatically take the UPS out of Bypass mode
variables.input.realpower: Current sum value of all (ePDU) phases real power (W)
variables.input.realpower.nominal: Nominal sum value of all (ePDU) phases real power (W)
variables.input.power: Current sum value of all (ePDU) phases apparent power (VA)
variables.output.inverter.latency: Delay of inverter activation when switching to battery (seconds, floating-point)
variables.battery.charge.approx: Rough approximation of battery charge (opaque, percent)
variables.battery.charge.low: Remaining battery level when UPS switches to LB (percent)
variables.battery.charge.restart: Minimum battery level for UPS restart after power-off
variables.battery.charge.warning: Battery level when UPS switches to "Warning" state (percent)
variables.battery.charger.status: Status of the battery charger (see the note below)
variables.battery.voltage.cell.max: Maximum battery voltage seen of the Li-ion cell (V)
variables.battery.voltage.cell.min: Minimum battery voltage seen of the Li-ion cell (V)
variables.battery.voltage.low: Minimum battery voltage, that triggers FSD status
variables.battery.status: Health status of the battery (opaque string)
variables.battery.temperature.cell.max: Maximum battery temperature seen of the Li-ion cell (degrees C)
variables.battery.temperature.cell.min: Minimum battery temperature seen of the Li-ion cell (degrees C)
variables.battery.runtime.low: Remaining battery runtime when UPS switches to LB (seconds)
variables.battery.runtime.restart: Minimum battery runtime for UPS restart after power-off (seconds)
variables.battery.date: Battery installation or last change date (opaque string)
variables.battery.date.maintenance: Battery next change or maintenance date (opaque string)
variables.battery.energysave: Switch off when running on battery and no/low load
variables.battery.energysave.load: Switch off UPS if on battery and load level lower (percent)
variables.battery.energysave.delay: Delay before switch off UPS if on battery and load level low (min)
variables.battery.energysave.realpower: Switch off UPS if on battery and load level lower (Watts)
variables.ambient.n.name: Ambient sensor name
variables.ambient.n.parent.serial: Ambient sensor parent serial number (opaque string)
variables.ambient.n.temperature.status: Ambient temperature status relative to the thresholds
variables.ambient.n.humidity.status: Ambient humidity status relative to the thresholds

variables.outlet.n.alarm: Alarms for outlets and PDU, published in ups.alarm voltage warning
variables.outlet.n.ecocontrol: Master Outlet used to automatically power off the slave outlets

variables.outlet.n.battery.charge.low: Remaining battery level to power off this outlet (percent)

variables.outlet.n.delay.start: Interval to wait before restarting this outlet (seconds)
variables.outlet.n.timer.shutdown: Time before the outlet load will be shutdown (seconds)
variables.outlet.n.timer.start: Time before the outlet load will be started (seconds)
variables.outlet.n.current.status: Current status relative to the thresholds
variables.outlet.n.voltage.status: Voltage status relative to the thresholds
variables.outlet.n.crestfactor: Crest Factor (dimensionless, equal to or greater than 1)
variables.outlet.group.n.color: Color-coding of the outlets in this group (OPAQUE)
variables.outlet.group.n.count: Number of outlets in the group
variables.outlet.group.n.phase: Electrical phase to which the physical outlet group (Gang) is connected to
variables.outlet.group.n.input: Input to which an outlet group is connected
variables.driver.name: Driver name
variables.driver.version.data: Version of the internal data mapping, for generic drivers
variables.driver.state: Current state in driver's lifecycle, primarily to help readers discern long-running init (with full device walk) or cleanup stages from the stable working loop init.device, init.info, init.updateinfo (first walk), reconnect.trying, reconnect.updateinfo, updateinfo, quiet, dumping, cleanup.upsdrv, cleanup.exit

commands.load.off.delay: Turn off the load possibly after a delay
commands.load.on.delay: Turn on the load possibly after a delay
commands.shutdown.default: Run default driver-defined (device-specific) routine, primarily intended for emergency poweroff performed as part of FSD handling; often an alias to other `shutdown.*` and/or `load.off` operations or a chain to try several of those. See also `sdcommands` in common driver options.
commands.shutdown.return: Turn off the load possibly after a delay and return when power is back
commands.shutdown.stayoff: Turn off the load possibly after a delay and remain off even if power returns
commands.shutdown.reboot: Shut down the load briefly while rebooting the UPS
commands.shutdown.reboot.graceful: After a delay, shut down the load briefly while rebooting the UPS
commands.test.battery.start.low: Start a battery test until battery low
commands.bypass.start: Put the UPS in Bypass mode
commands.bypass.stop: Take the UPS out of Bypass mode
commands.reset.input.minmax: Reset minimum and maximum input voltage status
commands.reset.watchdog: Reset watchdog timer (forced reboot of load)
commands.outlet.n.shutdown.return: Turn off the outlet and return when power is back

cmdvartabVariables.outlet.autoswitch.charge.low: Remaining battery level to power off this outlet (percent)
cmdvartabVariables.outlet.delay.shutdown: Interval to wait before shutting down this outlet (seconds)
cmdvartabVariables.outlet.delay.start: Interval to wait before restarting this outlet (seconds)
cmdvartabVariables.ups.load.energysave: Load on UPS that triggers energysave (percent)

cmdvartabCommands.driver.exit: Tell the driver daemon to just exit its program (so the caller or service management framework can restart it with new options)
cmdvartabCommands.driver.killpower: Tell the driver daemon to initiate UPS shutdown; should be unlocked with driver.flag.allow_killpower option or variable setting
cmdvartabCommands.driver.reload: Reload running driver configuration from the file system (only works for changes in some options)
cmdvartabCommands.driver.reload-or-error: Reload running driver configuration from the file system (only works for changes in some options); return an error if something changed and could not be applied live (so the caller can restart it with new options)
cmdvartabCommands.driver.reload-or-exit: Reload running driver configuration from the file system (only works for changes in some options); exit the running driver if something changed and could not be applied live (so service management framework can restart it with new options)
